Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
John Alston Campbell wrote:
> Just wondering if anyone knows of a program (preferably free) that will
> periodically search ebay for cards that I need and let me know when it finds
> one.

ww.ebay.com will do this automatically for you.

Just enter the search parameters and search.

On the results page, click on "Add to My Favorite Searches" (if the search
produced no hits, click on "Email me" under the "alternative searches"
heading" instead). Then follow the instructions to receive daily email
updates when new items show up that match your search.

Ebay allows 100 "active" favorite searches at a time.
If you need more, you'll have to create multiple usernames and email
addresses with Ebay.
